19:96.text: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - the Most Merciful will appoint for them affection.

19:97.text: that you may give good tidings thereby to the righteous and warn thereby a hostile people.

19:98.text: And how many have We destroyed before them of generations? Do you perceive of them anyone or hear from them a sound?

20:2.text: We have not sent down to you the Qur’ān that you be distressed

20:3.text: But only as a reminder for those who fear

20:4.text: A revelation from He who created the earth and highest heavens,

20:6.text: To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth and what is between them and what is under the soil.

20:7.text: And if you speak aloud - then indeed, He knows the secret and what is

20:8.text: Allāh - there is no deity except Him. To Him belong the best names.

20:9.text: And has the story of Moses reached you? -

20:10.text: When he saw a fire and said to his family, "Stay here; indeed, I have perceived a fire; perhaps I can bring you a torch or find at the fire some guidance."

20:11.text: And when he came to it, he was called, "O Moses,

20:12.text: Indeed, I am your Lord, so remove your sandals. Indeed, you are in the blessed valley of Ṭuwā.
